caption:
$1,000 off your taxable income, no receipts needed. It's real, and it starts with this income year (2026–27).

The new standard deduction applies automatically if you earn wages or other labour income. Any work expenses you claim reduce it dollar for dollar, so if your work costs are under $1,000 you end up with $1,000 either way. Spend more than $1,000 and have the records? Claim the lot instead. Union fees, tax agent fees, donations, personal super contributions, income protection and rental costs are still claimed on top.

On the 30% rate it's worth about $320 including Medicare. It doesn't apply to your 2025–26 return.

Save this for July 2027.

General info only, not personal advice.
